parts.text: $XOM Q3 2026: revenue $113.2B, +33% Y/Y, driven by sales growth and historically high global refining margins. Operating margin reached 18.8%. #earnings #oil
$PGR Q3 2026: revenue $23.2B, +3% Y/Y, driven by 6% growth in policies in force despite increased market competition. Operating margin 14.0%; operating cash flow $4.5B. #earnings #insurance
$MAR Q3 2026: revenue $7.0B, +8% Y/Y, driven by a 6.5% increase in worldwide RevPAR and higher co-branded credit card fees. Operating margin 18.2%; operating cash flow $1.4B. #earnings #consumer
$L Q3 2026: Revenue $4.8B, up 2% Y/Y, with net earnings of $322M. Profit fell due to CNA long-term care reserve updates and higher catastrophe losses. #earnings #insurance

$PUBLIX Q3 2026: revenue $15.7B, +1% Y/Y, as new supermarket sales were offset by pharmacy reimbursement changes and consumer spending. Operating margin 5.9%; operating cash flow $1.6B. #earnings #retail
$FOXA Q1 FY27: revenue $4.6B, +22% Y/Y, driven by advertising growth from the FIFA Men’s World Cup and political advertising. Operating margin 28.1%; operating cash flow $616M. #earnings #media
$CNA Q3 2026: revenue $3.8B (flat Y/Y) as lower underwriting results and higher catastrophe losses weighed on profits. Operating margin 6.2%; net earnings $196M. #earnings #insurance
$EL Q1 FY27: revenue $3.7B, +7% Y/Y, driven by growth in fragrance and skin care, led by La Mer and The Ordinary. Operating margin 11.0%; net earnings $233M. #earnings #consumer
$FANG Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $5.4B, +38% Y/Y, driven by oil production averaging 525 MBO/d. Operating margin 46.0%; operating cash flow $2.6B. #earnings #oil

$VRTX Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.4B, +12% Y/Y, driven by cystic fibrosis portfolio and ALYFTREK uptake, alongside contributions from CASGEVY and JOURNAVX. Operating margin 20.7%; net earnings $654M. #earnings #pharma
$NWP Q3 2026: revenue $3.2B, +10% Y/Y, driven by product sales. Operating margin 35.2% amid ongoing system expansions. #earnings #utilities
$WMB Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.2B, +10% Y/Y, driven by higher service revenues and the Momentum Midstream acquisition. Operating margin 35.2%. #earnings #utilities
